content_blocks.title: Practice reasoning
content_blocks.text: Cross-validation repeats model fitting across distinct train/validation folds. The score mean is an estimate, not a guarantee about future data. For grouped and temporal validation, keep the problem definition, data selection, estimator configuration, and evaluation criterion explicit. When results are uncertain, compare a baseline and inspect examples rather than treating one metric as a complete explanation.

content_blocks.code:
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
X, y = load_iris(return_X_y=True)
cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=0)
scores = cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000), X, y, cv=cv)
print(len(scores), round(float(scores.mean()), 3))

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Check input shapes, target alignment, data types, missing values, label order, and whether the expected output assumes a fixed random seed. Fit learned preprocessing only on training data, preferably inside a Pipeline. Do not select parameters by repeatedly looking at the final test set.
